from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from fractions import Fraction
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
from xml.etree import ElementTree

sys.path.insert(0, "public-artifacts/czifile")

import czifile
import imagecodecs
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path("public-artifacts/pylibczirw")
READER_ROOT = Path("public-artifacts/czifile")
EVIDENCE_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent


def sha256(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest().upper()


def raw_dimensions(stream, entry) -> list[dict]:
    stream.seek(entry.offset + 32)
    data = stream.read(entry.dimensions_count * 20)
    assert len(data) == entry.dimensions_count * 20
    return [
        {
            "axis": axis.rstrip(b"\x00").decode("cp1252"),
            "start": start,
            "size": size,
            "stored_size_raw": stored,
            "stored_size": stored or size,
        }
        for axis, start, size, physical, stored in struct.iter_unpack("<4siifi", data)
    ]


def inspect_asset(asset: dict) -> dict:
    path = ROOT / asset["path"]
    content = path.read_bytes()
    assert len(content) == asset["size_bytes"]
    assert sha256(content) == asset["sha256"]
    blocks = []
    attachments = []
    with path.open("rb") as stream, czifile.CziFile(path) as reader:
        metadata = reader.metadata()
        application_clues = []
        sensitive_tags = set()
        if metadata:
            tree = ElementTree.fromstring(metadata)
            for element in tree.iter():
                tag = element.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
                if tag in {"Application", "Software"}:
                    fields = {
                        child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]: child.text.strip()
                        for child in element
                        if child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] in {"Name", "Version", "Build"}
                        and child.text
                        and child.text.strip()
                    }
                    if fields:
                        application_clues.append(fields)
                if tag in {
                    "Patient",
                    "PatientID",
                    "PatientName",
                    "SubjectID",
                    "Donor",
                    "Experimenter",
                    "UserName",
                    "Operator",
                }:
                    if (element.text and element.text.strip()) or len(element):
                        sensitive_tags.add(tag)
        for index, entry in enumerate(reader.subblock_directory):
            dimensions = raw_dimensions(stream, entry)
            coordinates = {dimension["axis"]: dimension["start"] for dimension in dimensions}
            scales = {}
            for dimension in dimensions:
                if dimension["axis"] in {"X", "Y"} and dimension["stored_size"] > 0:
                    scale = Fraction(dimension["size"], dimension["stored_size"])
                    scales[dimension["axis"]] = [scale.numerator, scale.denominator]
            block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
            xml = block.metadata(fixesc=False)
            mask = block.mask()
            payload = block.data(raw=True)
            assert int(entry.compression) == 0
            native_pixels = np.frombuffer(payload, dtype=entry.pixel_type.dtype).reshape(entry.stored_shape)
            assert native_pixels.nbytes == block.data_size
            blocks.append(
                {
                    "directory_ordinal": index,
                    "directory_entry_offset": entry.offset,
                    "inline_entry_offset": block.directory_entry_offset,
                    "segment_offset": entry.file_position,
                    "dimensions": dimensions,
                    "coordinates": coordinates,
                    "pixel_type": int(entry.pixel_type),
                    "pixel_type_name": entry.pixel_type.name,
                    "dtype": str(entry.pixel_type.dtype),
                    "compression": int(entry.compression),
                    "pyramid_type": int(entry.pyramid_type),
                    "logical_to_stored_scale": scales,
                    "stored_shape": list(entry.stored_shape),
                    "decoded_bytes": math.prod(entry.stored_shape) * entry.pixel_type.dtype.itemsize,
                    "pixel_payload_bytes": block.data_size,
                    "native_pixel_sha256": sha256(native_pixels.tobytes(order="C")),
                    "native_pixel_reference": "Uncompressed payload reshaped to stored_shape; no color swap, resampling or mosaic composition",
                    "metadata_bytes": block.metadata_size,
                    "xml_utf8_sha256": sha256(xml.encode("utf8")),
                    "subblock_attachment_bytes": block.attachment_size,
                    "mask_recognized": mask is not None,
                    "mask_shape": None if mask is None else list(mask.shape),
                    "mask_bool_sha256": None if mask is None else sha256(mask.tobytes(order="C")),
                    "valid_mask_pixels": None if mask is None else int(np.count_nonzero(mask)),
                }
            )
        for attachment in reader.attachments():
            entry = attachment.attachment_entry
            payload = attachment.data(raw=True)
            attachments.append(
                {
                    "name": entry.name,
                    "type": str(entry.content_file_type),
                    "payload_bytes": len(payload),
                    "sha256": sha256(payload),
                }
            )
    m_counts = Counter(block["coordinates"]["M"] for block in blocks if "M" in block["coordinates"])
    return {
        "asset_id": asset["id"],
        "path": asset["path"],
        "application_clues": application_clues,
        "sensitive_metadata_tag_candidates": sorted(sensitive_tags),
        "privacy_state": "unverified; metadata-only screening cannot clear pixel data",
        "subblock_count": len(blocks),
        "m_omitted_count": sum("M" not in block["coordinates"] for block in blocks),
        "repeated_m_values": sorted(value for value, count in m_counts.items() if count > 1),
        "subblocks": blocks,
        "attachments": attachments,
        "pixel_payload_bytes": sum(block["pixel_payload_bytes"] for block in blocks),
        "decoded_tile_bytes": sum(block["decoded_bytes"] for block in blocks),
    }


def main() -> None:
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "pylibCZIrw/tests/integration/test_data/fixture_manifest.json").read_text())
    for asset in manifest["assets"]:
        for relative in [asset["path"], *asset["aliases"]]:
            content = (ROOT / relative).read_bytes()
            assert len(content) == asset["size_bytes"] and sha256(content) == asset["sha256"]
    records = [inspect_asset(asset) for asset in manifest["assets"] if asset["path"].endswith(".czi")]
    assert len(records) == 15
    assert not any(name in sys.modules for name in ("_pylibCZIrw", "pylibCZIrw", "libczi"))
    source = READER_ROOT / "czifile/czifile.py"
    provenance = {
        "python": sys.version,
        "czifile": czifile.__version__,
        "imagecodecs": imagecodecs.__version__,
        "numpy": np.__version__,
        "reader_commit": subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "-C", str(READER_ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True
        ).strip(),
        "reader_source_sha256": sha256(source.read_bytes()),
        "reader_package_worktree": subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "-C", str(READER_ROOT), "status", "--porcelain", "--", "czifile"], text=True
        ).strip(),
    }
    report = {
        "recorded_on": "2026-10-15",
        "kind": "independent structural observations; not new-API tests or corpus admission",
        "provenance": provenance,
        "assets": records,
    }
    (EVIDENCE_ROOT / "catalogue.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
    summary = [
        {
            "id": record["asset_id"],
            "blocks": record["subblock_count"],
            "compression": sorted({block["compression"] for block in record["subblocks"]}),
            "scales": sorted(
                {json.dumps(block["logical_to_stored_scale"], sort_keys=True) for block in record["subblocks"]}
            ),
            "xml_blocks": sum(block["metadata_bytes"] > 0 for block in record["subblocks"]),
            "masks": sum(block["mask_recognized"] for block in record["subblocks"]),
            "attachments": len(record["attachments"]),
            "m_absent": record["m_omitted_count"],
            "repeated_m": record["repeated_m_values"],
            "application_clues": record["application_clues"],
            "decoded_bytes": record["decoded_tile_bytes"],
        }
        for record in records
    ]
    print(json.dumps({"provenance": provenance, "summary": summary}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    reduced = 40000 + rows * 101 + columns * 7
    gap = np.zeros((32, 96), dtype=np.uint16)
    gap[:, :48] = base
    gap[:16, 72:] = reduced
    overlap = base.copy()
    overlap[:16, :24] = reduced
    results = []

        with czi.open_czi(str(directory / name)) as reader:
            actual = reader.read(plane={"T": 0, "C": 0, "Z": 0})

        results.append({"path": name, "literal_pixels_after_close": int(actual.size), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(actual.tobytes()).hexdigest().upper()})
    with czi.open_czi(str(directory / "stored_sparse_coordinates.czi")) as reader:
        entries = []

            entries.append({"index": index, "coordinates": info.coordinate.to_dict(), "rect": [info.logicalRect.x, info.logicalRect.y, info.logicalRect.w, info.logicalRect.h]})

        reader.enumerate_subblocks(collect)

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))

import czifile
import numpy as np
from make_edge_cases import segment, write_candidate


def digest(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest().upper()


def rewrite_coordinates(content: bytearray, entry, block, values: dict[str, int]) -> None:
    for offset in (entry.offset, block.directory_entry_offset):
        found = set()
        for ordinal in range(entry.dimensions_count):
            position = offset + 32 + ordinal * 20
            axis = bytes(content[position:position + 4]).rstrip(b"\0").decode("ascii")
            if axis in values:
                struct.pack_into("<i", content, position + 4, values[axis])
                found.add(axis)
        assert found == set(values)


def main() -> None:
    root = Path(__file__).parent
    templates = root / "synthetic-v2"
    directory = root / "assignment-inputs-v2"
    directory.mkdir()
    rows, columns = np.indices((32, 48), dtype=np.uint16)
    base = rows * 257 + columns * 11
    rows, columns = np.indices((16, 24), dtype=np.uint16)
    reduced = 40000 + rows * 101 + columns * 7
    inputs = (base, reduced)
    sparse_source = templates / "stored_levels_same_m37.czi"
    sparse = bytearray(sparse_source.read_bytes())
    sparse_coordinates = [
        {"S": 2, "T": 3, "C": 5, "Z": 7, "X": -8, "Y": -4},
        {"S": 8, "T": 9, "C": 11, "Z": 13, "X": 64, "Y": -4},
    ]
    with czifile.CziFile(sparse_source) as reader:
        for ordinal, entry in enumerate(reader.subblock_directory):
            block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
            rewrite_coordinates(sparse, entry, block, sparse_coordinates[ordinal])
            tree = ElementTree.Element("METADATA")
            ElementTree.SubElement(tree, "FixtureProbe", {"ordinal": str(ordinal)}).text = ["base", "reduced"][ordinal]
            xml = ElementTree.tostring(tree, encoding="utf8")
            prefix = bytearray(sparse[entry.file_position + 32:block.metadata_offset])
            position = len(sparse)
            struct.pack_into("<i", prefix, 0, len(xml))
            struct.pack_into("<q", prefix, 16 + struct.calcsize("<2si"), position)
            struct.pack_into("<q", sparse, entry.offset + struct.calcsize("<2si"), position)
            sparse.extend(segment("ZISRAWSUBBLOCK", prefix + xml + block.data(raw=True)))
    sparse_path = write_candidate(directory, "stored_sparse_coordinates.czi", sparse)
    template_path = templates / "levels_template.czi"
    template = template_path.read_bytes()
    gap = bytearray(template)
    with czifile.CziFile(template_path) as reader:
        for ordinal, entry in enumerate(reader.subblock_directory):
            block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
            rewrite_coordinates(gap, entry, block, {"X": [-8, 64][ordinal], "Y": -4})
    gap_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_tiles_with_gap.czi", gap)
    overlap_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_overlapping_tiles.czi", template)
    gap_expected = np.zeros((32, 96), dtype=np.uint16)
    gap_expected[:, :48] = base
    gap_expected[:16, 72:] = reduced
    overlap_expected = base.copy()
    overlap_expected[:16, :24] = reduced
    results = []
    for path in (sparse_path, gap_path, overlap_path):
        blocks = []
        with czifile.CziFile(path) as reader:
            metadata = reader.metadata()
            tags = {"Patient", "PatientID", "PatientName", "SubjectID", "Donor", "Experimenter", "UserName", "Operator"}
            if metadata:
                for element in ElementTree.fromstring(metadata).iter():
                    if element.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] in tags:
                        assert not (element.text or "").strip() and not len(element)
            for ordinal, entry in enumerate(reader.subblock_directory):
                block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
                expected = inputs[ordinal]
                actual = np.frombuffer(block.data(raw=True), dtype=np.uint16).reshape(expected.shape)
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
                logical = dict(zip(entry.dims, entry.shape, strict=True))
                stored = dict(zip(entry.dims, entry.stored_shape, strict=True))
                scales = {axis: Fraction(logical[axis], stored[axis]) for axis in ("X", "Y")}
                content = path.read_bytes()
                coordinates = {
                    axis.rstrip(b"\0").decode("ascii"): start
                    for axis, start, size, physical, stored_size in struct.iter_unpack(
                        "<4siifi", content[entry.offset + 32:entry.offset + 32 + entry.dimensions_count * 20]
                    )
                }
                if path == sparse_path:
                    assert all(coordinates[axis] == value for axis, value in sparse_coordinates[ordinal].items())
                    assert coordinates["M"] == 37
                    assert scales["X"] == scales["Y"] == [Fraction(1), Fraction(2)][ordinal]
                else:
                    assert scales["X"] == scales["Y"] == 1
                blocks.append({"ordinal": ordinal, "coordinates": coordinates, "shape_YX": list(expected.shape), "dtype": "uint16", "literal_pixel_sha256": digest(expected.tobytes()), "decoded_bytes": expected.nbytes, "scale": {axis: [value.numerator, value.denominator] for axis, value in scales.items()}, "xml": block.metadata(fixesc=False)})
            if path != sparse_path:
                expected = gap_expected if path == gap_path else overlap_expected
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(reader.asarray(maxworkers=1), expected)
        results.append({"path": path.name, "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest(path.read_bytes()), "blocks": blocks, "privacy": "literal numeric inputs; no nonempty sensitive global metadata tags", "expected_composed_sha256": None if path == sparse_path else digest((gap_expected if path == gap_path else overlap_expected).tobytes())})
    assert not any(name in sys.modules for name in ("_pylibCZIrw", "pylibCZIrw", "libczi"))
    report = {"recorded_on": "2026-10-15", "recipe": "bounded global/inline coordinate mutations and appended literal XML on refreshed literal templates; overlap is the unchanged two-write template", "checks": results, "gap_roi": {"roi": [40, -4, 24, 16], "shape_YX": [16, 24], "expected": "uint16 zeros; present level with internal uncovered region"}, "out_of_coverage_roi": {"roi": [200, 200, 48, 32], "expected": "uint16 zeros at selected present level"}, "missing_level": {"S": 2, "plane": {"T": 3, "C": 5, "Z": 7}, "absent_scale": [2, 1], "expected": "missing-level error, not black fill or fallback"}, "limits": "Independent input/reference checks only; future public APIs and their I/O/error/lifetime contracts remain implementation work."}
    (root / "assignment-inputs.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from io import BytesIO
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys
from uuid import UUID

sys.path.insert(0, "public-artifacts/czifile")

import czifile
import numpy as np


def segment(name: str, content: bytes | bytearray) -> bytes:
    allocated = (len(content) + 31) // 32 * 32
    return struct.pack("<16sqq", name.encode("ascii"), allocated, len(content)) + bytes(content).ljust(
        allocated, b"\x00"
    )


def write_candidate(directory: Path, name: str, content: bytes | bytearray) -> Path:
    path = directory / name
    assert not path.exists()
    path.write_bytes(content)
    return path


def main() -> None:
    root = Path(__file__).parent
    directory = root / "synthetic-v2"
    original = (directory / "literal_gray16_raw.czi").read_bytes()
    generation = json.loads((root / "generation.json").read_text())
    raw_hash = next(asset["sha256"] for asset in generation["assets"] if asset["path"] == "literal_gray16_raw.czi")
    assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest().upper() == raw_hash
    assert len(original) % 32 == 0
    rows, columns = np.indices((32, 48), dtype=np.uint16)
    literal = rows * 257 + columns * 11
    expected_mask = (rows + columns) % 3 != 0
    bits = np.packbits(expected_mask, axis=1, bitorder="big").tobytes()
    guid = b"g\xea\xe3\xcb\xfc[+I\xa1j\xec\xe3x\x03\x14H"
    mask_data = struct.pack("<IIII", 48, 32, 0, 6) + bits
    chunk = guid + struct.pack("<i", len(mask_data)) + mask_data
    with czifile.CziFile(directory / "literal_gray16_raw.czi") as reader:
        entry = reader.subblock_directory[0]
        block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
        assert block.attachment_size == 0
        block_content = bytearray(original[entry.file_position + 32 : block.data_offset + block.data_size])
        global_entry_offset = entry.offset
    mask_position = len(original)
    struct.pack_into("<i", block_content, 4, len(chunk))
    struct.pack_into("<q", block_content, 16 + struct.calcsize("<2si"), mask_position)
    masked = bytearray(original)
    struct.pack_into("<q", masked, global_entry_offset + struct.calcsize("<2si"), mask_position)
    masked.extend(segment("ZISRAWSUBBLOCK", block_content + chunk))
    valid_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_valid_mask.czi", masked)
    with czifile.CziFile(valid_path) as reader:
        mask = reader.subblock_directory[0].read_segment_data(reader).mask()
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(mask, expected_mask)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(reader.asarray(maxworkers=1), np.where(expected_mask, literal, 0))
    corrupt = bytearray(masked)
    chunk_size_offset = mask_position + 32 + len(block_content) + 16
    struct.pack_into("<i", corrupt, chunk_size_offset, 8)
    corrupt_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_corrupt_mask.czi", corrupt)
    with czifile.CziFile(corrupt_path) as reader:
        assert reader.subblock_directory[0].read_segment_data(reader).mask() is None
    outer = bytearray(original)
    entries = []
    definitions = [
        ("Label", "CZI", original),
        ("Preview", "CZI", original),
        ("Preview", "CZI", original),
        ("Unknown", "OTHER", b"synthetic-opaque"),
        ("Corrupt", "CZI", b"CZI!"),
    ]
    seed = UUID("11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555")
    for ordinal, (name, kind, payload) in enumerate(definitions):
        position = len(outer)
        entry = struct.pack(
            "<2s10sqi16s8s80s",
            b"A1",
            bytes(10),
            position,
            0,
            UUID(int=seed.int + ordinal).bytes,
            kind.encode("ascii"),
            name.encode("ascii"),
        )
        assert len(entry) == 128
        entries.append(entry)
        data = struct.pack("<i12x", len(payload)) + entry + bytes(112) + payload
        outer.extend(segment("ZISRAWATTACH", data))
    attachment_directory_position = len(outer)
    directory_data = struct.pack("<i252x", len(entries)) + b"".join(entries)
    outer.extend(segment("ZISRAWATTDIR", directory_data))
    struct.pack_into("<q", outer, 32 + struct.calcsize("<iiii16s16siqqi"), attachment_directory_position)
    attachment_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_attachment_cases.czi", outer)
    attachment_results = []
    with czifile.CziFile(attachment_path) as reader:
        attachments = list(reader.attachments())
        assert len(attachments) == 5
        assert sum(attachment.attachment_entry.name == "Preview" for attachment in attachments) == 2
        for attachment, (name, kind, expected_payload) in zip(attachments, definitions, strict=True):
            payload = attachment.data(raw=True)
            assert payload == expected_payload
            observed = {
                "name": name,
                "type": kind,
                "payload_bytes": len(payload),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest().upper(),
            }
            if name in {"Label", "Preview"}:
                with czifile.CziFile(BytesIO(payload)) as nested:
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(nested.asarray(maxworkers=1), literal)
                observed["exact_literal_pixels"] = int(literal.size)
            if name == "Corrupt":
                try:
                    with czifile.CziFile(BytesIO(payload)):
                        raise AssertionError("Corrupt image unexpectedly accepted")
                except ValueError as error:
                    observed["observed_error"] = type(error).__name__
            attachment_results.append(observed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(reader.asarray(maxworkers=1), literal)
    records = [
        {
            "path": str(path),
            "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
        }
        for path in (valid_path, corrupt_path, attachment_path)
    ]
    report = {
        "recorded_on": "2026-10-15",
        "recipe": "bounded appended native-format segments on the private literal Gray16 template; fixed attachment GUIDs and literal payloads; known mask[y,x]=(y+x)%3!=0",
        "valid_mask_pixels": int(expected_mask.sum()),
        "mask_sha256": hashlib.sha256(expected_mask.tobytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
        "corrupt_mask": {
            "chunk_size_offset": chunk_size_offset,
            "declared_chunk_size": 8,
            "minimum_valid_size": 16,
            "observed_czifile_result": "None (tolerated corruption); future API error is not certified",
        },
        "attachments": attachment_results,
        "assets": records,
        "limits": "Private bounded candidates, not corpus admission, public writer features or new-API pass. Corrupt-mask validation is structural because czifile tolerates invalid chunks. No original fixture, private metadata value or baseline environment changed.",
    }
    (root / "edge-checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def dimensions(content: bytes | bytearray, offset: int, count: int) -> list[tuple]:
    return [
        (offset + 32 + index * 20, *struct.unpack_from("<4siifi", content, offset + 32 + index * 20))
        for index in range(count)
    ]


def main() -> None:
    root = Path(__file__).parent
    directory = root / "synthetic-v2"
    template = directory / "levels_template.czi"
    original = template.read_bytes()

    assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest().upper() == generation["sha256"]
    existing = json.loads((root / "catalogue.json").read_text())
    assert not any(block["coordinates"].get("M", 0) < 0 for asset in existing["assets"] for block in asset["subblocks"])
    pyramid_type = next(
        block["pyramid_type"]
        for asset in existing["assets"]
        for block in asset["subblocks"]
        if block["logical_to_stored_scale"]["X"] == [2, 1]
    )
    entries = []
    with czifile.CziFile(template) as reader:
        assert len(reader.subblock_directory) == 2
        for entry in reader.subblock_directory:
            block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
            entries.append(
                {"global": entry.offset, "inline": block.directory_entry_offset, "count": entry.dimensions_count}
            )
    mutated = bytearray(original)
    base_m_offsets = []
    for ordinal, entry in enumerate(entries):
        for copy in ("global", "inline"):
            offset = entry[copy]
            for position, axis, start, size, physical, stored in dimensions(mutated, offset, entry["count"]):
                axis = axis.rstrip(b"\x00").decode("ascii")
                if axis == "M":
                    assert start == ordinal
                    struct.pack_into("<i", mutated, position + 4, 37)
                    if ordinal == 0:
                        base_m_offsets.append(position + 4)
                if ordinal == 1 and axis in {"X", "Y"}:
                    assert size == {"X": 24, "Y": 16}[axis]
                    struct.pack_into("<i", mutated, position + 8, {"X": 48, "Y": 32}[axis])
                    struct.pack_into("<i", mutated, position + 16, size)
            if ordinal == 1:
                struct.pack_into("<B", mutated, offset + struct.calcsize("<2siqii"), pyramid_type)
    assert len(base_m_offsets) == 2
    negative = bytearray(mutated)
    for offset in base_m_offsets:
        struct.pack_into("<i", negative, offset, -7)
    base_rows, base_columns = np.indices((32, 48), dtype=np.uint16)
    base = base_rows * 257 + base_columns * 11
    level_rows, level_columns = np.indices((16, 24), dtype=np.uint16)

    results = []
    for name, content, expected_m in (
        ("stored_levels_same_m37.czi", mutated, [37, 37]),
        ("stored_levels_negative_m7.czi", negative, [-7, 37]),
    ):
        path = directory / name
        assert not path.exists()
        path.write_bytes(content)
        with czifile.CziFile(path) as reader:
            raw_m = []
            scales = []
            for ordinal, entry in enumerate(reader.subblock_directory):
                raw = {
                    axis.rstrip(b"\x00").decode("ascii"): (start, size, stored or size)
                    for position, axis, start, size, physical, stored in dimensions(
                        content, entry.offset, entry.dimensions_count
                    )
                }
                raw_m.append(raw["M"][0])
                scale = Fraction(raw["X"][1], raw["X"][2])
                assert scale == Fraction(raw["Y"][1], raw["Y"][2])
                scales.append([scale.numerator, scale.denominator])
                expected = base if ordinal == 0 else reduced
                assert (raw["Y"][2], raw["X"][2]) == expected.shape
                block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
                actual = np.frombuffer(block.data(raw=True), dtype=np.uint16).reshape(expected.shape)
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
            assert raw_m == expected_m and scales == [[1, 1], [2, 1]]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(reader.asarray(maxworkers=1), base)
        results.append(
            {
                "path": str(path),
                "size_bytes": len(content),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest().upper(),
                "m_values": raw_m,
                "scales": scales,
                "stored_pixels": "exact literal arrays",
                "reduced_min": int(reduced.min()),
                "base_max": int(base.max()),
                "changed_byte_offsets_from_template": [
                    index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(original, content)) if before != after
                ],
            }
        )
    report = {
        "recorded_on": "2026-10-15",
        "recipe": generation["recipe"],
        "mutation": "bounded DV global/inline X/Y logical/stored sizes, observed pyramid type, and raw M start; no explicit-M writer API",
        "limits": "Private synthetic candidates. Future M-selection/stored-level APIs and error contracts are not implemented or certified by this structural/pixel check.",
        "checks": results,
    }
    (root / "levels-checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

import struct
import sys
from xml.etree import ElementTree

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
sys.path.insert(0, "public-artifacts/czifile")

import czifile
import numpy as np
from make_edge_cases import segment, write_candidate


def main() -> None:
    root = Path(__file__).parent
    directory = root / "synthetic-v2"
    original = (directory / "literal_gray16_raw.czi").read_bytes()
    mask_file = directory / "literal_valid_mask.czi"
    with czifile.CziFile(mask_file) as reader:
        block = reader.subblock_directory[0].read_segment_data(reader)
        mask_content = mask_file.read_bytes()[
            block.data_offset + block.data_size : block.data_offset + block.data_size + block.attachment_size
        ]
    with czifile.CziFile(directory / "literal_gray16_raw.czi") as reader:
        entry = reader.subblock_directory[0]
        block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
        prefix = bytearray(original[entry.file_position + 32 : block.metadata_offset])
        pixels = block.data(raw=True)
        global_offset = entry.offset
    tree = ElementTree.Element("METADATA")
    schema = ElementTree.SubElement(tree, "AttachmentSchema")
    ElementTree.SubElement(schema, "DataFormat").text = "CHUNKCONTAINER"
    xml = ElementTree.tostring(tree, encoding="utf8")
    position = len(original)
    struct.pack_into("<i", prefix, 0, len(xml))
    struct.pack_into("<i", prefix, 4, len(mask_content))
    struct.pack_into("<q", prefix, 16 + struct.calcsize("<2si"), position)
    output = bytearray(original)
    struct.pack_into("<q", output, global_offset + struct.calcsize("<2si"), position)
    output.extend(segment("ZISRAWSUBBLOCK", prefix + xml + pixels + mask_content))
    valid_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_valid_mask_v2.czi", output)
    rows, columns = np.indices((32, 48), dtype=np.uint16)
    literal = rows * 257 + columns * 11
    expected_mask = (rows + columns) % 3 != 0
    with czifile.CziFile(valid_path) as reader:
        block = reader.subblock_directory[0].read_segment_data(reader)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(block.mask(), expected_mask)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(reader.asarray(maxworkers=1), np.where(expected_mask, literal, 0))
        assert block.metadata(fixesc=False).encode("utf8") == xml
        chunk_offset = block.data_offset + block.data_size + 16
    malformed = bytearray(output)
    struct.pack_into("<i", malformed, chunk_offset, 8)
    corrupt_path = write_candidate(directory, "literal_corrupt_mask_v2.czi", malformed)
    with czifile.CziFile(corrupt_path) as reader:
        assert reader.subblock_directory[0].read_segment_data(reader).mask() is None
    report = {
        "recorded_on": "2026-10-15",
        "repair": "add required METADATA/AttachmentSchema/DataFormat=CHUNKCONTAINER; unchanged literal pixels and mask bits",
        "superseded": ["literal_valid_mask.czi", "literal_corrupt_mask.czi"],
        "assets": [
            {
                "path": str(path),
                "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
            }
            for path in (valid_path, corrupt_path)
        ],
        "valid_mask_pixels": int(expected_mask.sum()),
        "native_interoperability": "pending focused rerun",
    }
    (root / "mask-repair.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        assert fields[-1].rstrip(b"\0") == b"Preview"
        inline_offset = fields[2] + 32 + 16
        for offset in (global_offset, inline_offset):
            name_offset = offset + struct.calcsize("<2s10sqi16s8s")
            assert bytes(content[name_offset:name_offset + 80]).rstrip(b"\0") == b"Preview"
            content[name_offset:name_offset + 80] = b"SlidePreview".ljust(80, b"\0")
            changed.append([name_offset, 80])
    path = root / "assignment-inputs-v2/literal_slidepreview_cases.czi"
    assert not path.exists()
    path.write_bytes(content)
    rows, columns = np.indices((32, 48), dtype=np.uint16)

def main() -> None:
    root = Path(__file__).parent
    directory = root / "synthetic-v2"
    generation = json.loads((root / "generation.json").read_text())
    for asset in generation["assets"]:
        content = (directory / asset["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert len(content) == asset["size_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest().upper() == asset["sha256"]
    rows, columns = np.indices((32, 48), dtype=np.uint16)
    literal = rows * 257 + columns * 11
    with np.load(directory / "literal_gray16.npz", allow_pickle=False) as archive:
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(archive["arr"][:, :, 0], literal)
    results = []
    offsets = None
    metadata_offset = None
    for codec, compression_code in (("raw", 0), ("zstd0", 5), ("zstd1", 6)):
        with czifile.CziFile(directory / f"literal_gray16_{codec}.czi") as reader:
            image = next(iter(reader.scenes.values()))
            assert image.axes == "YX"
            assert len(reader.subblock_directory) == 1
            entry = reader.subblock_directory[0]
            assert int(entry.compression) == compression_code
            assert int(entry.pixel_type) == 1
            block = entry.read_segment_data(reader)
            actual = reader.asarray(maxworkers=1)
            assert actual.shape == literal.shape and actual.dtype == literal.dtype
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, literal)
            results.append(
                {
                    "codec": codec,
                    "compression_code": compression_code,
                    "exact_pixels": int(actual.size),
                    "payload_bytes": block.data_size,
                    "decoded_output_bytes": actual.nbytes,
                }
            )
            if codec == "raw":
                compression_offset = struct.calcsize("<2siqi")
                offsets = [entry.offset + compression_offset, block.directory_entry_offset + compression_offset]
                if block.metadata_size:
                    metadata_offset = block.metadata_offset
    original = (directory / "literal_gray16_raw.czi").read_bytes()
    mutated = bytearray(original)
    assert offsets is not None and len(set(offsets)) == 2
    for offset in offsets:
        assert struct.unpack_from("<i", mutated, offset)[0] == 0
        struct.pack_into("<i", mutated, offset, 42)
    assert [index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(original, mutated)) if before != after] == sorted(offsets)
    negative = directory / "literal_gray16_unsupported42_v2.czi"
    assert not negative.exists()
    negative.write_bytes(mutated)
    try:
        with czifile.CziFile(negative) as reader:
            reader.asarray(maxworkers=1)
    except ValueError as error:
        assert "42" in str(error)
        results.append(
            {
                "case": "unsupported-compression",
                "compression_code": 42,
                "changed_byte_offsets": offsets,
                "observed_error": type(error).__name__,
                "message": str(error),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(mutated).hexdigest().upper(),
            }
        )
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Independent reader unexpectedly accepted unsupported compression 42")
    if metadata_offset is not None:
        mutated_xml = bytearray(original)
        mutated_xml[metadata_offset] = 255
        negative_xml = directory / "literal_gray16_invalid_utf8.czi"
        assert not negative_xml.exists()
        negative_xml.write_bytes(mutated_xml)
        try:
            with czifile.CziFile(negative_xml) as reader:
                reader.subblock_directory[0].read_segment_data(reader).metadata(fixesc=False)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            results.append(
                {

                    "changed_byte_offset": metadata_offset,
                    "observed_error": "UnicodeDecodeError",
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(mutated_xml).hexdigest().upper(),

            )
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Independent reader unexpectedly accepted invalid XML UTF8")
    assert not any(name in sys.modules for name in ("_pylibCZIrw", "pylibCZIrw", "libczi"))
    report = {
        "recorded_on": "2026-10-15",
        "reference": "literal uint16[y,x] = 257*y + 11*x, not CZI readback",
        "axis_alignment": "CZI YX equals literal YX; saved NPZ has one trailing component",
        "limits": "Private candidates, not corpus admission or new-API tests. Decoder uses imagecodecs Zstd, not libCZI; Zstd implementations share the compression format/library family. Negative errors are observed czifile errors, not certification of future pylibCZIrw errors.",
